name: colorectal_histology
description: A labeled histopathology image dataset for colorectal tissue that measures models' ability to classify microscopic image patches into tissue types (e.g., tumor, stroma, inflammatory). It evaluates visual recognition performance for diagnostic/biomedical image classification tasks and is used to benchmark CNNs and other vision models on medical image classification.
reputation: Widely used in computational pathology and medical imaging research as a standard benchmark for colorectal tissue classification.
